thread:
asha: quick thread to lock the company OKR v0.3 for sign-off. new item: tie 'unit-cost-per-1k-tokens' to batching + quantization work. need acceptance criteria, rollout readiness, and decision log by EOD. @tom @miguel @sam

 tom: read it. overall ok. we should call out explicit launch criteria for Dedicated customers and a fallback if quantization introduces accuracy regressions.

 miguel: design side: i've got dashboard mock + changelog screenshots in figma, will push link to product board. need short copy for customer comms (50–80 chars).

 sam: ops notes: need infra runbook and canary schedule. propose 3-stage rollout: internal -> limited dedicated beta -> hosted. rollback: auto-fallback to previous model variant with circuit breaker.

 asha: suggested acceptance criteria: 1) unit cost reduction >= 12% on 95th pct workload vs baseline; 2) p99 latency <= 10% degradation; 3) canary at >5% traffic for 48h w/ no uncaught errors; 4) runbook + playbook written and reviewed.

 priya: +1. also add evaluation criterion: no regression in hallucination/error rate on the canonical eval set (redwood-evals).

 sara: legal flag: for Dedicated customers include data residency and migration opt-out in comms. will draft short clause.

 tom: engineering caveat — quantized variant adds ~+5ms median for some sequence lengths. mitigation: per-shape kernel selection but that needs a perf budget approval.

 asha: decision-log draft: accept up to +5ms median if unit cost reduction >= 15% for targeted workloads. tom to open perf ticket and ETA.

 tom: filed PERF-4521 for kernel selection work. ETA two weeks. link will be in confluence.

 miguel: i'll prepare final customer-facing changelog blurb + screenshots. need copy by thursday to hit customer comms cadence.

 sam: canary plan: start 1% internal traffic, advance to 5% beta, then 25% staggered over a week. alerting thresholds: token errors >0.5% or latency spike >3x baseline triggers immediate rollback.

 sara: :thumbsup: drafting the legal snippet now.

 priya: if all acceptance criteria and runbook are met, i sign off. when ready, please post a single-line 'OK to launch' here with links to runbook + perf report.

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary slot reserved in infra-calendar for 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC.

 asha: noted. action owners: tom (perf tickets + benchmarks), sam (runbook & canary), miguel (comms), sara (legal). i'll assemble decision log and evidence bundle for priya.

 tom: perf testing underway. will post bench artifacts to confluence under PERF-4521 when done: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PERF/4521

 sara: legal snippet (draft): 'Dedicated customers will receive 14 days advance notice with migration options and confirmation of data residency. Customers may opt-out of automated migration and receive manual assistance.'

 miguel: posted figma + changelog draft: https://figma.com/redwood/okrdraft — screenshots and simple CTA ready.

 asha: quick status check EOD: please reply with short status line (done / in-progress / blocked).

 tom: perf: in-progress (bench + regression 50% complete).

 sam: runbook: in-progress (draft ready, tightening rollback steps).

 miguel: comms: done (draft complete, awaiting final copy signoff).

 sara: legal: done (draft ready).

 asha: great. we'll reconvene tomorrow morning for final signoff. i'll post decision-log + acceptance checklist then. thanks everyone.
